findings: Non-blocking: selected rows now come from selection.selectedOptions instead of the selectedOptions prop. The default singleSelection keeps only the first entry, so a future caller that passes several options or a mismatched selection would see different selected/open-highlight state. Current callers (Select with at most one option, Multiselect with multiSelection built from the same array) are unaffected, and the precondition is documented in the JSDoc.
